facts.text: Eleven guys, one dinner table. Danny, don't be late, and tell Linus to stop sweating into the bread basket.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Rusty's words, but it is not a line from the film. Linus is the pickpocket, so a bread basket joke can work as a note. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Eleven guys, one dinner table. Danny, don't be late, and somebody watch Linus around the bread basket.
